Assign Taxonomy Using RDP Classifier

Source: R/vtamR_RDP.R
assign_taxonomy_rdp.Rd

Assigns 16S bacterial and archaeal sequences to taxonomic ranks using the RDP classifier via the rRDP package.

Usage

assign_taxonomy_rdp(
  asv,
  dir = NULL,
  max_memory = 1,
  confidence = 0.8,
  rm_chloroplast = TRUE,
  outfile = "",
  quiet = TRUE,
  sep = ",",
  log_file = NULL
)

Arguments

asv

Data frame or CSV file containing asv_id and asv columns.

dir

Character string; path to a directory containing an existing trained classifier (created with trainRDP()). If NULL, the default RDP-trained classifier is used.

max_memory

Positive integer; maximum RAM available for rRDP in GB.

confidence

Numeric (0–1); minimum confidence threshold for accepting a taxonomic assignment.

rm_chloroplast

Logical; if TRUE, taxonomic assignments are set to NA when the class is Chloroplast.

outfile

Character string: name of the output CSV file. If empty, no file is written.

quiet

Logical; if TRUE, suppress informational messages and show only warnings or errors.

sep

Field separator character for input and output CSV files.

log_file

Character string specifying the path to the CSV log file. The path is resolved with the following priority:

  1. the log_file argument, if explicitly provided by the user;

  2. the vtamR.log_file option set with options(vtamR.log_file = ...), if set;

  3. "vtamR_log.csv" in the current working directory, used as a last resort if neither of the above is set.

To disable logging entirely, set log_file = NA.

Value

A data frame with the following columns: asv_id, domain, kingdom, phylum, class, order, family, genus.

Details

This function requires the rRDP, rRDPData, and Biostrings packages.

By default, the RDP 16S Bacteria/Archaea reference database provided by rRDPData is used (http://sourceforge.net/projects/rdp-classifier/). Alternatively, a custom trained classifier directory (created using trainRDP()) can be provided.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
taxa <- assign_taxonomy_rdp(
  asv = read_count_df,
  confidence = 0.7,
  max_memory = 8,
  rm_chloroplast = FALSE
)
} # }
